recipes.title: French Toast Cloud (3 ingredients, 75 g protein)
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Whisk the vanilla Greek yogurt, eggs and cornstarch until completely smooth and creamy.
Pour into a parchment-lined baking dish and bake for about 1 hour, until puffed and deep golden brown on top.
Lift out on the parchment, dust with powdered sugar and drizzle with caramel or syrup.
recipes.notes: The creator gives 75 g protein for the whole thing; calories, carbs and fat are estimated (non-fat vanilla Greek yogurt) and exclude the toppings. It's a custardy, cheesecake-like bake that tastes like French toast. Split it in two for a more typical breakfast portion.
